paite: TOUPA phat un! TOUPA pahtawi in la thak sa unla, misiangthoute kikhopna ah aphatna la sa un.
heading: Israelte Tung A Pathian Hoihna Phatna La
english: Praise Yahweh! Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

paite: Israelte amau siampa tung ah kipak uhenla; Zion tate akumpipa uh tung ah nuam uhen.
english: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

paite: Amin lou in phat uhenla; khuangta leh kaihging toh amah phat in la sa uhen.
english: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

paite: TOUPA amite tung ah akipak a; thunuailutte hotdamna in azem ding hi.
english: For Yahweh takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

paite: Misiangthoute thupina ah kipaktak in om uhenla; alupna tungte uah nuam in la sa uhen!
english: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.

paite: Pathian pahtawi a phatna akam uah om henla, akhut uah namsau hiamtuah om hen.
english: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

paite: Namte tung a phu la a, michih tung a gawtna tungsak ding leh,
english: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

paite: akumpipate uh khainiang a hen a, amihoihte uh sikkolte bunsak ding leh,
english: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

paite: atung ua vaihawm gelhsa tungsak ding in; huai kilawmna a misiangthou tengteng in anei chiat uhi, TOUPA phat un!
english: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise Yah!
